name: azure-authentication
description:
Authenticates requests to Azure-hosted backends, such as Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI, with a short-lived
Microsoft Entra ID access token instead of a static API key. With AKS Workload Identity, the gateway exchanges the
service account token projected into its pod for an access token of the user-assigned managed identity federated
with that service account, so no secret is configured on the API. With a managed identity, the gateway gets the
access token from the Azure Instance Metadata Service of the VM, VM scale set or AKS node it runs on. Tokens are
cached per identity and scope, shared across routes, and refreshed in the background before they expire.
